translations.idiomatic: 〈The ancient melody is lost.〉

sentences.zh: 《唐堯》言聖皇陟帝位，德化光四表也。

translations.literal: "Tang Yao" speaks of the sage emperor ascending the imperial throne—virtue's transforming light shining to the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: "Tang Yao" celebrates the sage emperor's accession: his transforming virtue radiated to the four corners of the earth.

sentences.zh: 唐堯咨務成，謙謙德所興。

translations.literal: Tang Yao consulted Wu Cheng; humble, humble—virtue thus arose.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Yao consulted Wu Cheng; humble, humble—virtue thus arose.

sentences.zh: 積漸終光大，履霜致堅氷。

translations.literal: Accumulating gradually, at last glorious and great; treading frost brought solid ice.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulating gradually, at last glorious and great; treading frost brought solid ice.

sentences.zh: 神明道自然，河海猶可凝。

translations.literal: Spirits bright—the Way is natural; rivers and seas can still congeal.
translations.idiomatic: Spirits bright—the Way is natural; rivers and seas can still congeal.

sentences.zh: 舜禹統百揆，元凱以次升。

translations.literal: Shun and Yu oversaw the hundred affairs; chief worthies rose in order.
translations.idiomatic: Shun and Yu oversaw the hundred affairs; chief worthies rose in order.

sentences.zh: 禪讓應天歷，睿聖世相承。

translations.literal: Abdication answered to Heaven's calendar; sage wisdom passed down through generations.
translations.idiomatic: Abdication answered to Heaven's calendar; sage wisdom passed down through generations.

sentences.zh: 我皇陟帝位，平衡正準繩。

translations.literal: Our emperor ascended the imperial throne; the balance level, the plumb line straight.
translations.idiomatic: Our emperor ascended the imperial throne; the balance level, the plumb line straight.

sentences.zh: 德化飛四表，祥氣見其徵。

translations.literal: Virtue's transforming power flew to the four quarters; auspicious vapor showed its signs.
translations.idiomatic: Virtue's transforming power flew to the four quarters; auspicious vapor showed its signs.

sentences.zh: 興王坐俟旦，亡主恬自矜。

translations.literal: The rising king sat awaiting dawn; the perishing lord smugly prided himself.
translations.idiomatic: The rising king sat awaiting dawn; the perishing lord smugly prided himself.

sentences.zh: 致遠由近始，覆簣成山陵。

translations.literal: Reaching far begins from what is near; overturned baskets became hills and mounds.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching far begins from what is near; overturned baskets became hills and mounds.

translations.idiomatic: Unrolling the chart, consulting ancient registers—there was proof of numen.

translations.idiomatic: "Dark Clouds" celebrates the sage emperor's use of talent: every man was put to the full measure of his ability.

sentences.zh: 玄雲起山嶽，祥氣萬里會。

translations.literal: Dark clouds rose from mountains and peaks; auspicious vapor gathered for ten thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Dark clouds rose from mountains and peaks; auspicious vapor gathered for ten thousand li.

translations.idiomatic: How winding the dragon's flight; how fluttering the phoenix's soaring.

translations.literal: In the past, in the court of Tang and Yu—at times seen at the edge of azure clouds.
translations.idiomatic: In the past, in the court of Tang and Yu—at times seen at the edge of azure clouds.

sentences.zh: 今親遊方國，流光溢天外。

translations.literal: Now in person touring the regions; flowing light overflowed beyond the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Now in person touring the regions; flowing light overflowed beyond the sky.

sentences.zh: 鶴鳴在後園，清音隨風邁。

translations.literal: Cranes called in the rear garden; clear notes followed the wind in advance.
translations.idiomatic: Cranes called in the rear garden; clear notes followed the wind in advance.

sentences.zh: 成湯隆顯命，伊摯來如飛。

translations.literal: Cheng Tang exalted the manifest mandate; Yi Zhi came like flying.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Tang exalted the manifest mandate; Yi Zhi came like flying.

sentences.zh: 周文獵渭濱，遂載呂望歸。

translations.literal: King Wen of Zhou hunted on the Wei shore; then carried Lü Wang home.
translations.idiomatic: King Wen of Zhou hunted on the Wei shore; then carried Lü Wang home.

sentences.zh: 符合如影響，先天天弗違。

translations.literal: Tallies matched like shadow and echo; before Heaven, none opposed.
translations.idiomatic: Tallies matched like shadow and echo; before Heaven, none opposed.

translations.idiomatic: Leaving the plow, he gathered earth's guiding cords; doffing coarse cloth, he grasped Heaven's sustaining threads.

sentences.zh: 元功配二主，芬馨世所稀。

translations.literal: Primordial merit matched two lords; fragrance rare in the world.
translations.idiomatic: Primordial merit matched two lords; fragrance rare in the world.

sentences.zh: 我皇敘羣才，洪烈何巍巍。

translations.literal: Our emperor arranged the host of talents; how towering the great glory.
translations.idiomatic: Our emperor arranged the host of talents; how towering the great glory.

sentences.zh: 桓桓征四表，濟濟理萬機。

translations.literal: Mighty, mighty, campaigning to the four quarters; abundant, abundant, ordering ten thousand mechanisms.
translations.idiomatic: Mighty, mighty, campaigning to the four quarters; abundant, abundant, ordering ten thousand mechanisms.

sentences.zh: 神化感無方，髦才盈帝畿。

translations.literal: Divine transformation moved without limit; outstanding talents filled the imperial domain.
translations.idiomatic: Divine transformation moved without limit; outstanding talents filled the imperial domain.

sentences.zh: 丕顯惟昧旦，日新孔所咨。

translations.literal: Greatly manifest—only before dawn; daily renewal—what Confucius praised.
translations.idiomatic: Greatly manifest—only before dawn; daily renewal—what Confucius praised.

sentences.zh: 茂哉聖明德，日月同光輝。

translations.literal: Abundant, the sage bright virtue—sun and moon shared its radiance.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant, the sage bright virtue—sun and moon shared its radiance.

translations.idiomatic: "Bo Yi"—ancient "Yellow Sparrow" piece.

translations.idiomatic: 〈The ancient melody is lost.〉

translations.idiomatic: "Bo Yi" recalls how the red crow bore a book and the Duke of Zhou rose to power;

translations.literal: now the sage emperor received the mandate—the divine sparrow has come.
translations.idiomatic: now the sage emperor has received the mandate, and the divine sparrow has come.

sentences.zh: 伯益佐舜禹，職掌山與川。

translations.literal: Bo Yi assisted Shun and Yu; his office governed mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Yi assisted Shun and Yu; his office governed mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 德侔十六相，思心入無閒。

translations.literal: Virtue matched the sixteen ministers; his thoughtful heart entered without idle moments.
translations.idiomatic: Virtue matched the sixteen ministers; his thoughtful heart entered without idle moments.

sentences.zh: 智理周萬物，下知眾鳥言。

translations.literal: Wisdom ordered all the myriad things; below, he knew the speech of the many birds.
translations.idiomatic: Wisdom ordered all the myriad things; below, he knew the speech of the many birds.

sentences.zh: 黃雀應清化，翔集何翩翩。

translations.literal: Yellow sparrows answered to clear transformation; how gracefully they flew and gathered.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow sparrows answered to clear transformation; how gracefully they flew and gathered.

sentences.zh: 和鳴棲庭樹，徘徊雲日間。

translations.literal: Harmonious calls, roosting in courtyard trees; lingering between clouds and sun.
translations.idiomatic: Harmonious calls, roosting in courtyard trees; lingering between clouds and sun.

sentences.zh: 夏桀為無道，密網施山阿。

translations.literal: Xia Jie was without the Way; dense nets were set on mountain slopes.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Jie was without the Way; dense nets were set on mountain slopes.

sentences.zh: 酷祝振纖網，當柰黃雀何。

translations.literal: Cruel curses shook fine nets—what could be done for the yellow sparrows?
translations.idiomatic: Cruel curses shook fine nets—what could be done for the yellow sparrows?

sentences.zh: 殷湯崇天德，去其三面羅。

translations.literal: Yin Tang exalted Heaven's virtue; removed three sides of the nets.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Tang exalted Heaven's virtue; removed three sides of the nets.

sentences.zh: 逍遙羣飛來，鳴聲乃復和。

translations.literal: Free and easy, flocks came flying; their calling voices again harmonized.
translations.idiomatic: Free and easy, flocks came flying; their calling voices again harmonized.

sentences.zh: 朱雀作南宿，鳳皇統羽羣。

translations.literal: Vermillion Bird served as southern constellation; phoenix ruled the feathered flocks.
translations.idiomatic: Vermillion Bird served as southern constellation; phoenix ruled the feathered flocks.

sentences.zh: 赤鳥銜書至，天命瑞周文。

translations.literal: Red bird bearing a book arrived; Heaven's mandate auspicious for King Wen of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Red bird bearing a book arrived; Heaven's mandate auspicious for King Wen of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 神雀今來遊，為我受命君。

translations.literal: Divine sparrow now comes visiting—for our mandate-receiving lord.
translations.idiomatic: Divine sparrow now comes visiting—for our mandate-receiving lord.

sentences.zh: 嘉祥致天和，膏澤降青雲。

translations.literal: Fine omens brought Heaven's harmony; rich moisture descended from azure clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Fine omens brought Heaven's harmony; rich moisture descended from azure clouds.

sentences.zh: 蘭風發芳氣，闔世同其芬。

translations.literal: Orchid wind released fragrant vapor; the whole age shared its scent.
translations.idiomatic: Orchid wind released fragrant vapor; the whole age shared its scent.

translations.idiomatic: "Fishing Rod"—ancient "Fishing Rod" piece.

translations.idiomatic: 〈Among the Han "Nao Songs" of twenty-two pieces, there is no "Fishing Rod."〉

translations.literal: How slowly the fishing rod; sweet bait fragrant and fresh.
translations.idiomatic: How slowly the fishing rod; sweet bait fragrant and fresh.

sentences.zh: 臨川運思心，微綸沈九淵。

translations.literal: Facing the stream, deploying thoughtful heart; fine line sank to the nine depths.
translations.idiomatic: Facing the stream, deploying thoughtful heart; fine line sank to the nine depths.

sentences.zh: 太公寶此術，乃在靈秘篇。

translations.literal: Grand Duke treasured this art—it lay in the numinous secret scroll.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Duke treasured this art—it lay in the numinous secret scroll.

translations.literal: Mechanism and change followed things' movement; subtle mastery pierced what was not yet.
translations.idiomatic: Mechanism and change followed things' movement; subtle mastery pierced what was not yet.

translations.literal: Swimming fish startled, caught on the hook; hidden dragon flew, reaching Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Swimming fish startled, caught on the hook; hidden dragon flew, reaching Heaven.

translations.idiomatic: Reaching Heaven—where would it arrive? Beating wings, soaring in Grand Clarity.

translations.literal: How strange Grand Clarity; the two principles emerged from the undifferentiated whole.
translations.idiomatic: How strange Grand Clarity; the two principles emerged from the undifferentiated whole.

sentences.zh: 玉衡正三辰，造化賦羣形。

translations.literal: Jade balance corrected the three seasons; creation bestowed forms on the multitude.
translations.idiomatic: Jade balance corrected the three seasons; creation bestowed forms on the multitude.

sentences.zh: 退願輔聖君，與神合其靈。

translations.literal: Retiring, he wished to assist the sage lord; with the spirits, his numen joined.
translations.idiomatic: Retiring, he wished to assist the sage lord; with the spirits, his numen joined.

sentences.zh: 我君弘遠略，天人不足并。

translations.literal: Our lord expanded far-reaching strategy; Heaven and men were not enough to match him.
translations.idiomatic: Our lord expanded far-reaching strategy; Heaven and men were not enough to match him.

sentences.zh: 天人初并時，昧昧何茫茫。

translations.literal: When Heaven and men first joined—how dim, how vast and boundless.
translations.idiomatic: When Heaven and men first joined—how dim, how vast and boundless.

sentences.zh: 日月有徵兆，文象興二皇。

translations.literal: Sun and moon had their portents; civil patterns raised the two emperors.
translations.idiomatic: Sun and moon had their portents; civil patterns raised the two emperors.

sentences.zh: 蚩尤亂生民，黃帝用兵征萬方。

translations.literal: Chiyou threw the people into chaos; Yellow Emperor used arms to campaign in the myriad regions.
translations.idiomatic: Chiyou threw the people into chaos; Yellow Emperor used arms to campaign in the myriad regions.

sentences.zh: 逮夏禹而德衰，三代不及虞與唐。

translations.literal: Reaching Xia and Yu, virtue declined; the Three Dynasties did not match Yu and Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Xia and Yu, virtue declined; the Three Dynasties did not match Yu and Tang.

sentences.zh: 我皇聖德配堯舜，受禪即阼享天祥。

translations.literal: Our emperor's sage virtue matched Yao and Shun; receiving abdication, ascending the throne, enjoying Heaven's auspice.
translations.idiomatic: Our emperor's sage virtue matched Yao and Shun; receiving abdication, ascending the throne, enjoying Heaven's auspice.
